name: Ravenholdt
summary: In the mountains above the Hillsbrad Foothills, Ravenholdt wages a shadow war against the Syndicate. Lord Jorach Ravenholdt leads the Assassin's League, a company of rogues, thieves, and killers that keeps clear of faction politics. It recruits the most cunning operatives across Azeroth, prized for discipline, stealth, and lethal efficiency.

sections.title: The Hidden League
sections.body:
Ravenholdt Manor gathers Azeroth's foremost brotherhood of assassins in the mountains between Hillsbrad and Alterac. Lord Jorach Ravenholdt leads the League beyond the reach of kings and warchiefs.

Master Kang teaches close combat and assassination, while the Thunderwood brothers brew rare, deadly poisons. Gnome craftsmen build intricate locks to test new disciples. For anyone who is not a rogue, entering the estate courts death; one careless step can bring a poisoned dagger to the ribs.

sections.title: Shadow War with the Syndicate
sections.body: For years, Ravenholdt has waged an escalating feud against the Syndicate, an aristocratic criminal cartel that infests Alterac and Arathi. The League sees its rivals as clumsy, arrogant amateurs, yet their numbers make them impossible to wipe out through slaughter alone. So contracted rogues pickpocket the signet emblems worn by Syndicate ringleaders. Ravenholdt counts on the Syndicate's paranoia and ruthless hierarchy to execute its disgraced members from within.

sections.title: An Independent Guild of Shadows
sections.body:
Ravenholdt sometimes works with other intelligence groups, including Stormwind's SI:7, but answers to no crown. Master Mathias Shaw can find an ally in Jorach Ravenholdt against the Syndicate, yet Jorach guards his independence fiercely.

When SI:7 suffered heavy losses investigating the fallen ranger Nathanos Marris in the Plaguelands, Ravenholdt flatly refused Shaw's plea for help. The League chooses its own battles, pursuing ancient relics, perfecting deadly arts, and keeping its blade at the throat of anyone foolish enough to cross it.

faq.answer: Ravenholdt is an ancient, hidden guild of thieves, assassins, and shadow-dancers led by Lord Jorach Ravenholdt. Also called the Assassin's League, it works from a secret mountain estate above the Hillsbrad Foothills, trains promising rogues, and offers deadly contracts.

faq.q: Why are they fighting the Syndicate?
aliases: why do they hate the syndicate
faq.answer: Ravenholdt and the Syndicate vie for dominance across the ruins of Alterac and the surrounding highlands. The League sees the Syndicate as undisciplined, dishonorable brigands whose messy crimes threaten the region's subtle balance of power. Rather than destroy them through attrition, Ravenholdt undermines their leadership by stealing their rank emblems.

aliases: can other classes go to ravenholdt
faq.answer: Non-rogues can reach Ravenholdt Manor, but entering the estate courts death. Its residents hint at poisoned drinks and daggers in the back for anyone who arrives without shadowcraft credentials or business with Lord Ravenholdt.

Lord Jorach Ravenholdt is the elusive master of the Assassin's League. From his mountain estate, he directs rogue trainers and informants across the continents, sending trusted disciples to recover powerful artifacts and neutralize rival threats.

faq.q: What is the Rite of Cunning?
faq.answer: The Rite of Cunning is an introductory test for those seeking entry to Ravenholdt Manor. An initiate must use trap-detection skills to pass through the mountain tunnel to the grounds, where the rite's danger becomes clear.

faq.q: How does Ravenholdt view the Alliance and the Horde?
faq.answer: Ravenholdt keeps entirely apart from Alliance and Horde politics, accepting skilled cutthroats from Orgrimmar or Ironforge alike. It maintains cordial ties with groups such as Stormwind's SI:7, but refuses to serve any kingdom's war effort.

angles.text: As a rogue, Ravenholdt is your far-reaching fraternity and proving ground. Its trainers, poison-brewers, and shadowmasters offer trials, rare weapon schematics, and recognition found nowhere else in Azeroth.
Mathias Shaw and SI:7 sometimes work with Ravenholdt against the Syndicate, but Lord Ravenholdt owes Stormwind no allegiance and may casually rebuff high-stakes Alliance requests.
Though Ravenholdt has a noble human exterior and lies in the northern highlands, it judges operatives by prowess alone. Horde stalkers are welcome if they prove their mettle.
